title: Work items know the kb facts they rest on
goal: Every story and task names the knowledge it needs as kb lookup questions and stable references (topic, QK answer, source id, fact key); research that the kb lacks is scheduled before the work that needs it; agents start from the packs of that knowledge instead of rediscovering it.
notes: Unanswered questions block an item until a research task covers them. A research item is a task with research: true whose check is pack giving coverage good. show, next and horizon run pack; the SessionStart hook does not. The brief command (story 4) and the skill changes (story 5) are built only after the measurement (story 6) shows a saving.
